raw_text: Node.js Nacos addon: Rust (`src/*.rs`, `nacos-sdk-rust`) via napi-rs; TS definitions `index.d.ts` auto-generated. Yarn 3.4.1. Build: `yarn build:debug`; target: `yarn build --target <target-triple>`. Test: `yarn test __test__/index.spec.mjs` (build `index.node` first). Clients are stateful; create once/reuse. Async methods return Promises; callbacks use ThreadsafeFunction; errors become JS Error. `removeListener/unSubscribe` are NOOPs. If build fails, ensure Rust toolchain is up to date: `rustup update stable && cargo update`
